findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and violates common cryptographic key management requirements.

No explicit key policy is defined, so the key falls back to the AWS default policy that delegates all key permissions to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or administer this log-encryption key. An explicit least-privilege key policy should scope usage to the logging service and specific roles.
